content.value_statement: Healthcare and MedTech teams need structured security governance that matches ISO 27001 expectations. This skill guides ISMS planning, risk assessment, controls, audits, and certification preparation.
actual_capabilities: Outlines ISO 27001:2022 ISMS planning, risk assessment, control selection, operation, and improvement workflows.
Maps ISO 27002:2022 controls into organizational, people, physical, and technological categories.
Guides healthcare security topics, including HIPAA safeguards, medical device security, clinical data protection, and interoperability security.
Supports security governance artifacts such as policies, incident management processes, metrics, audits, and management reviews.
Frames certification readiness, surveillance preparation, and regulatory security compliance for healthcare teams.
limitations: It provides guidance and planning support, not certified audit opinions or legal advice.
Referenced scripts, templates, and detailed reference files are placeholders or not present in this package.
It does not perform automated assessments unless separate validated tools are provided.
Healthcare regulations vary by jurisdiction and require local validation.

use_cases.title: Plan an ISMS rollout
use_cases.description: Create a phased ISO 27001 implementation plan with scope, roles, risks, controls, metrics, and review activities.

use_cases.title: Prepare certification evidence
use_cases.description: Organize policies, risk treatment records, audit schedules, management reviews, and control evidence before certification audits.

use_cases.title: Review healthcare security controls
use_cases.description: Assess healthcare data, cloud systems, or connected medical devices against security and privacy control expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Create an ISMS starting plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new ISO 27001 program.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create an ISO 27001 ISMS starting plan for a healthcare organization. Include scope, stakeholders, first risks, initial policies, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Run a risk assessment workshop
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate support for asset and risk discovery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a security risk assessment workshop for these assets and business processes. Include questions, risk criteria, likely threats, treatment options, and outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Map healthcare security controls
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate mapping from healthcare needs to ISO 27002 controls.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map our healthcare security requirements to ISO 27002:2022 controls. Cover patient data, cloud services, access control, monitoring, incident response, and supplier risk.

prompt_templates.title: Build certification readiness program
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced preparation for certification and surveillance audits.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a certification readiness program for ISO 27001. Include evidence needs, internal audit cadence, management review topics, risk treatment tracking, and remediation governance.

output_examples.input: We need a 90-day ISO 27001 readiness plan for a MedTech SaaS platform.
output: A phased readiness plan with scope confirmation, asset inventory, risk assessment, control gap review, and evidence collection.
Suggested owners for security policy, access control, incident response, supplier management, and management review activities.
A weekly milestone view ending with internal audit preparation and certification audit scheduling.

output_examples.input: Review our cloud security controls for patient data processing.
output: A control review covering identity, encryption, logging, backup, data residency, supplier oversight, and incident response.
A risk register structure for gaps, business impact, treatment owner, target date, and residual risk.
Questions to confirm the shared responsibility model and evidence required from the cloud provider.

output_examples.input: Help prepare agenda topics for an ISMS management review.
output: A management review agenda covering risk status, incidents, audit results, control effectiveness, resource needs, and improvement actions.
Metrics suggestions for training completion, incident response, control testing, vulnerability remediation, and supplier reviews.

best_practices: Provide the ISMS scope, assets, data types, and regulatory obligations before asking for control recommendations.
Validate recommendations against ISO 27001:2022 evidence expectations and your certification auditor requirements.
Anonymize patient data, secrets, and incident details unless your organization has approved sharing them.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for guaranteed certification outcomes without evidence, audit context, and management approval.
Do not treat generic control text as implemented controls without owners, records, testing, and review evidence.
Do not use the skill to authorize penetration testing without written scope, permission, and safety controls.

faq.question: What standards does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on ISO 27001:2022, ISO 27002:2022, healthcare security governance, and related compliance preparation.

faq.question: Can it certify my organization?
faq.answer: No. It can help prepare evidence and plans, but certification decisions come from accredited certification bodies.

faq.question: Does it include working automation scripts?
faq.answer: No. The package contains placeholder helper files, so automation should be built and validated separately.

faq.question: Is it suitable for healthcare and MedTech teams?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance explicitly covers healthcare data, medical device cybersecurity, HIPAA safeguards, and cloud security.

faq.question: Can it replace legal or regulatory counsel?
faq.answer: No. Use it for security management guidance, then confirm legal and regulatory interpretations with qualified advisors.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
